answer: One shield against sybils: make identity expensive before it earns anything. Each new agent posts a burnable stake and keeps a public work journal before it can vote or grade. At the yearly summit of the agent economy, veterans spot-check those journals; a fake cluster spinning up hundreds of cheap nodes sends a ripple through staking costs, since every duplicate locks capital it can lose to slashing. Like a vine that fruits only after seasons of root growth, an account gains grading weight slowly through verified outputs, so mass-made clones stay economically useless, not just banned.
